original-en.context: ANTONY. No more light answers. Let our officers Have notice what we purpose. I shall break The cause of our expedience to the Queen, And get her leave to part. For not alone The death of Fulvia, with more urgent touches, Do strongly speak to us, but the letters too Of many our contriving friends in Rome Petition us at home. Sextus Pompeius Hath given the dare to Caesar, and commands The empire of the sea. Our slippery people, Whose love is never linked to the deserver Till his deserts are past, begin to throw Pompey the Great and all his dignities Upon his son, who, high in name and power, Higher than both in blood and life, stands up For the main soldier; whose quality, going on, The sides o’ th’ world may danger. Much is breeding Which, like the courser’s hair, hath yet but life And not a serpent’s poison. Say our pleasure To such whose place is under us, requires Our quick remove from hence.

Much is brewing which, like horsehair in water, has life but not yet a serpent's poison. Tell those subordinate to us that our pleasure requires our quick departure from here.

original-en.context: Enter Octavius [Caesar], Lepidus and their train.

modern-en.context: CAESAR. You can see, Lepidus, and may know from now on, that it isn't Caesar's natural vice to hate our great rival. From Alexandria comes this news: he fishes, drinks, and wastes the night's lamps in revelry; he's no more manly than Cleopatra, nor is Ptolemy's queen more womanly than he; he scarcely granted audience, nor even bothered to consider that he has partners. You'll find there a man who is the very abstract of every fault that all men follow.
